tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live job openings from companies' own career pages. Filter by keywords (role, skill or company), location (a city such as Bengaluru, or "India") and remote. Returns up to 20 jobs, newest first, each with a Pamposhun link.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full details of one job opening by its id (from search_jobs): description, required skills, pay when listed, and the Pamposhun link where Pamposhun can apply for the person with their OK.

tools.name: match_resume_to_jobs
tools.description: Find openings that fit a resume. Give the resume text and the role wanted (and optionally a location). Returns the best-fitting jobs with the skills each one asks for that the resume shows, and the ones it does not. The resume is used for this answer only and never stored.
